==Acquisition==

==Related skills==
* {{skill icon|Disrupting Stab}}

==Notes==
*Exhausting Assault is the only dual attack skill that doesn't require an [[off-hand attack]] skill to precede it.
*This skill will inflict overcast on its target even if the interruption is prevented.
*As this is an [[attack skill]], the [[activation time]] is actually {{1/4}} second.
*If the target is [[Skill queue|skill queuing]], this attack can interrupt two skills. This way, it is possible to inflict 20 overcast with one attack.
*A target [[elementalist]] may actually benefit from the effects of this skill, as some of their [[Overcast#Skills_that_benefit_from_overcast|skills gain additional effects while the caster is overcast]].

==Trivia== 
*This skill's name stems from the fact that [[Overcast]] was called exhaustion at the time of implementation.
